title: Width after restricting a term
statement: Let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, and assign each coordinate either the restriction free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The width of the formula obtained by restricting $T$ equals $0$ if any literal of $T$ is falsified by a fixed coordinate; otherwise it equals the number of literals of $T$ whose coordinates are free.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF term on n coordinates
A restriction assigning each coordinate one of free, fixed to 1, or fixed to -1
